promoted.name: Accounting variance and adjustment resolution
promoted.definition: Investigating and clearing operational accounting differences: prior month adjustments, intercompany accrual variances, potential write-offs, and ledger, flash and inventory balances that do not agree.
include: Monthly prior month adjustment files and schedules
Intercompany accrual or volume variances between affiliates
Potential write-offs in a ledger close
Volume write-off letters and approvals
Preliminary ledgers sent for review
Suggestions to improve the variance process
exclude: Volume reconciliation with a customer or pipeline: volume-imbalance-reconciliation

promoted.name: Audit support requests
promoted.definition: Answering external auditors' testing requests: deal tickets, confirmations, P&L top pages, curve shift backup, origination support and valuations for sampled deals, and deciding who on the desk gathers them.
include: Monthly or quarterly auditor request lists for a desk
Deal tickets and confirmations for sampled deals
P&L top sheets and curve shift reports for testing
Valuations provided for a counterparty's auditors
Explanations of how recorded deal values were derived

promoted.name: Budget preparation and reporting
promoted.definition: Collecting staffing needs and drafts from managers for the next year's budget, and distributing monthly budget and budget-versus-actual reports to cost center managers.
include: Budget questionnaires and staffing requirements
Draft budgets and revisions
Monthly budget versus actual reports
O&M budget reports by cost center
exclude: Monthly cost center allocation percentages: cost-center-allocation

promoted.name: Business continuity planning
promoted.definition: Preparing to run the desks away from the normal office: backup seat assignments and counts, testing of backup seats, and surveys of how nominations would be made remotely.
include: Backup or contingency seat assignments and testing
Desk counts needed at a backup floor
Surveys of remote nomination access to pipelines

promoted.name: Contract administration
promoted.definition: Handling the life of gas transport, purchase and sale contracts: requests for new, amended or extended contracts, credit approval, routing for signature, status lists, contract system set-up, terminations and assignment reports.
include: Shipper requests to amend, extend or increase a transport contract
Credit approval submissions for shipper contracts
Contracts routed for signature and executed copies returned
Contract status lists and assignment, termination and expiration reports
Termination letters and evergreen checks
Lists of contracts pulled from the contract system for review
exclude: Contract needed for meter flow: meter-flow-deal-coverage
Rates on transport usage tickets: transport-rate-ticket-entry

promoted.name: Cost center allocation and charge review
promoted.definition: Setting the plan and monthly cost allocation percentages for groups and cost centers, and checking that charges, labor and workorders land on the right cost center and company.
include: Plan and monthly allocation percentages and revisions
Charges on cost center reports questioned or corrected
Labor distribution reports checked for who charges a cost center
Workorders set up or corrected for project costs
Employees moved between operating companies
exclude: Time reports and activity surveys: time-activity-reporting

promoted.name: Counterparty trading status notices
promoted.definition: Telling traders which counterparties they may or may not trade with, and passing on counterparties' notices that they are suspending deliveries.
include: Instructions to stop trading with a counterparty
Notices that a counterparty is cleared or not cleared
Supplier notices suspending gas deliveries

promoted.name: Forward curve validation review
promoted.definition: Explaining to the monthly curve validation group why forward price curves changed shape, level or seasonality, and answering their follow-up questions.
include: Monthly curve validation questions for a region
Explanations of curve changes
exclude: Curve files and post ID mappings: curve-postid-mapping

promoted.name: Customer event planning
promoted.definition: Organizing customer appreciation events and trips: proposals and approval forms, guest lists, invitations, RSVPs, rooming lists, itineraries and rescheduling.
include: Customer trip proposals, agendas and guest lists
Invitations and RSVP deadlines for customer meetings or trips
Rooming lists, itineraries and packing lists
Customer happy hour announcements and changes
exclude: Business meetings and calls with customers: meeting-scheduling

promoted.name: Customer list compilation
promoted.definition: Compiling and passing on lists of customers, prospects and market participants with their volumes or contact details for commercial and origination staff.
include: Requests for lists of the largest customers
Master customer lists built from team members' lists
Customer and prospect information sent to originators
Customers and contract volumes compiled for an agreement

promoted.name: Customer price quotes
promoted.definition: Getting trader quotes or bids for a customer's requested gas volumes, hedges, swaps or fixed forward purchases, and following up with the customer.
include: Customer hedge volumes and swap quotes
Requests for bids on packages of gas
Fixed forward purchase quotes
Swap profile spreadsheets reviewed with the customer

promoted.name: Daily service model delivery
promoted.definition: Completing, reconciling and sending the daily real-time deal models, sheets and hourly data files for service customers such as EES and El Paso Electric, and keeping the recipient lists right.
include: Daily model or sheet files sent with the date
Reconciliation sheets checked against desk reports
Hourly data files in the daily send-out

promoted.name: Deal booking rules and questions
promoted.definition: Setting, explaining and enforcing how deals are entered, booked, linked and changed in the deal capture systems, and answering questions on how a specific deal should be booked.
include: Deal entry instructions for a desk, book or deal type
Reminders of booking, linking and tagging rules
Controls on changing online or system-entered deals
Questions on whether a deal is booked correctly
Revised deal templates for book administrators
Reconciling entered deals against broker records
exclude: Fixing or zeroing a specific deal record: deal-record-correction

promoted.name: Deal confirmation handling
promoted.definition: Sending, requesting and chasing written confirmations of gas purchases and sales between the desk, counterparties and the groups that record them.
include: Executed gas sales confirmations sent on
Counterparties asking for confirmation copies
Chasing a missing purchase confirmation

promoted.name: Deal lookup and cross-system linking
promoted.definition: Finding deal ticket numbers and existing deals across Sitara, Tagg, EOL and other systems on request, and linking deal numbers so each system references the others.
include: Requests for the ticket or Sitara number of a deal
Queries for existing deals with a counterparty
Cross-references between deal numbers in two systems
Checks that new deals are linked between systems
exclude: Correcting or killing a deal record: deal-record-correction
Rules for how deals are booked: deal-booking-standards

promoted.name: Deal entry and pathing for scheduling
promoted.definition: Entering gas deals and pathing them in the scheduling system each month: buybacks, swings, storage and transport paths and customer finals, so volumes schedule, actualize and balance.
include: Monthly buyback and swing set-up for industrial customers
Requests to path deals at a meter, interconnect or storage point
Storage sale deals entered, pathed and balanced
Customer final schedules created for volume management
Reviews of monthly set-up and links in the scheduling system
exclude: Nominations from customers and suppliers: gas-nomination-handling
Flow with no deal or contract: meter-flow-deal-coverage

promoted.name: Desk equipment and telecom set-up
promoted.definition: Ordering, installing and tracking desk equipment for traders and staff: turrets, phones, headsets, PCs and mobile phones, including order status, receipt confirmation and phone plan costs.
include: Turret, handset and phone line set-up or moves
PC orders, installs and status notices
Headset and phone orders through the office assistant
Cell phone plans, limits and bills
Confirming ordered hardware was received so invoices can clear
exclude: Moving staff to a new floor or building: office-move-coordination

promoted.name: Business sale transition
promoted.definition: Coordinating the hand-over of a business sold to a new owner: transition issue lists, deal and customer lists for the buyer, data, file and system migration, and moving staff with orientation and paperwork.
include: Transition issue lists and procedures for a pipeline or trading business hand-over
Deal or customer lists prepared for the buyer
Data, spreadsheet and system migration notices and fixes
Orientation sessions, access cards and new-employer paperwork for moving staff
exclude: Moving deals to bankruptcy books: deal-book-transfer

promoted.name: Internal annuity deal booking
promoted.definition: Entering, revising and explaining internal annuity deals that move revenue or profit shares between trading books for a specific transaction.
include: Requests to enter or revise an annuity between books
Explanations of profit-share annuities for a deal

promoted.name: ISO adjustment and dec bidding
promoted.definition: Setting up and running decremental and adjustment bids in the ISO markets for the desk and on behalf of generators, and instructing the real-time group how to enter and tier them.
include: Dec bidding strategy and settlement
Instructions on tiered adjustment bids
Generator buy-back or dec bid actions

promoted.name: Liquidation support
promoted.definition: Supplying the supporting detail, deal lists and volume files behind monthly liquidation values requested by risk or accounting, and saving them to the shared directory.
include: Support for liquidation flash values
Volumes files for monthly liquidations
Deal detail requested for liquidation support

promoted.name: Market price and analysis distribution
promoted.definition: Passing daily market reports, published price data, index prices and market analysis to traders, originators and customers, on schedule or on request.
include: Daily energy market reports forwarded to traders
Published gas price data sent to the desk
Monthly index prices supplied on request
Load, supply and market analysis passed on

promoted.name: Meeting and conference call scheduling
promoted.definition: Arranging internal and customer meetings and conference calls: inviting attendees, collecting attendance replies, booking rooms and catering, setting agendas and dial-in details, and scheduling off-sites.
include: Management lunches, staff meetings and team off-sites
Attendance replies for group or trader meetings
Meeting room and catering reservations
Conference calls with a customer, with agenda and dial-in
exclude: Strategy meetings for the commercial plan: commercial-strategy-planning
Review meetings in the PRC cycle: performance-review
Customer appreciation events and trips: customer-event-planning

promoted.name: Meter and facility set-up
promoted.definition: Setting up and maintaining meter, point and facility records in the facilities and scheduling systems: new meters and points, replacement changeovers, zone mapping, measurement and estimate files, and data checks.
include: Notices that a new meter or point was created
Changeover from an old meter to its replacement
Meter set-up changes such as rate zone or pipe code
Zone or point re-mapping requests
State and county verification for meters
exclude: Flow with no deal or contract: meter-flow-deal-coverage

promoted.name: Office move coordination
promoted.definition: Coordinating staff relocations to a new floor or building: move schedules and labelling with facilities, packing and clean-up instructions, and clearing items left in vacated desks.
include: Move dates, times and labelling instructions
Packing and clean-up reminders before a move
Requests to clear items left in unoccupied desks
exclude: Backup seats for an emergency: contingency-planning
Phones and turrets at the new desk: desk-equipment-requests

promoted.name: Origination credit booking
promoted.definition: Granting origination credit for deals to the right books and groups, checking that claimed amounts were granted, reconciling recognized amounts between books, and keeping the origination schedule and report accurate.
include: Requests to grant origination for a deal and month
Corrections to how origination is coded to books
Checks of claimed origination against tickets
Origination schedule or daily report corrections
exclude: Internal annuity deals between books: internal-annuity-booking

promoted.name: P&L reserve tracking
promoted.definition: Requesting, allocating and announcing reserves held against desk P&L: amounts put on or released from Schedule C and credit reserves taken on counterparty deals.
include: Notices that amounts went on or came off Schedule C
Requests for a credit reserve on a transaction
Corrections to credit reserves charged to a desk

promoted.name: Price index evaluation
promoted.definition: Reviewing published or proposed power price indexes, their definitions, methodology and submission templates, and deciding whether and how to take part.
include: Hourly or hour-ahead index templates
Comments on index definitions before launch

promoted.name: Process and controls documentation
promoted.definition: Writing and reviewing documents that describe how a group works: controls and standards lists, activity definitions, transaction flow documents and process write-ups, circulated for comments.
include: Controls and standards lists per group
Activity definitions for a team
Draft process or transaction flow documents with reviewer edits

promoted.name: Real-time desk procedures and briefings
promoted.definition: Real-time desk leads circulating procedures, transmission paths and prices, data sources, record-keeping rules and market guidance so the group runs the desk the same way.
include: Transmission paths, OASIS sites and wheeling procedures
New transmission prices and losses treatment
Changes to where desk data is collected
Record keeping and outage reporting procedures
Briefings on market changes and counterparty handling

promoted.name: Recruiting and analyst staffing
promoted.definition: Filling open positions and placing rotating analysts and associates: needs assessments, requisitions and job postings, candidate resumes and referrals, interview scheduling and feedback to HR.
include: Analyst and associate needs assessments and placement requests
Staff requisitions and headcount approval for vacancies
Job postings and internal openings with suggested candidates
Interview scheduling, interviewer availability and feedback on candidates
Recommendation letters or endorsements for analyst program candidates
exclude: Training classes for current staff: staff-training-coordination

promoted.name: Staff training coordination
promoted.definition: Arranging training for staff: scheduling internal classes and system training sessions, choosing topics, enrolling people in courses and approving their attendance or registration.
include: Internal classes on P&L, risk or systems procedures
System training sessions such as a new scheduling or accounting system
Course registration and approval requests
Cross-training and desk sit-ins
exclude: Written desk procedures and briefings: realtime-desk-procedures

promoted.name: Time off approval
promoted.definition: Employees requesting vacation or days off, managers approving or negotiating the dates, and confirming the management vacation calendar.
include: Vacation or day-off requests and approvals
Revisions to the management vacation calendar
exclude: Holiday entries on time reports: time-activity-reporting

promoted.name: Transport rate and charge ticket entry
promoted.definition: Entering and updating monthly transport usage tickets, service rates and demand charges on deals, and correcting missing or wrong rates that cause prior month adjustments.
include: Monthly transport usage tickets with rates and volumes
Missing service or expense contract rates before close
Demand charges entered on the matching deal
Deals updated for finalized transport invoices
Questions whether a transport rate carries to a replacement contract

promoted.name: Work responsibility assignment
promoted.definition: Assigning and announcing who handles which pipelines, meters, counterparties, books or regions, and handing work over when people change roles.
include: Announcements of who covers which pipelines or accounts
Risk book or P&L responsibility by region
Handover of a task to another person or group
Rotations onto a new scheduling area
